champions.name: Bramble
champions.title: Sapling of the Greenwall
champions.star1: A small wooden creature wearing moss like armour, fists of knotted root.
champions.star2: Larger, plated in armoured bark with glowing green runes; flowers bloom along the shoulders and roots trail when he walks.
champions.star3: A miniature ancient world-tree warrior. Leaves orbit him, his eyes burn emerald, and Rootslam erupts as enormous spectral roots.
champions.lore: The Greenwall forests sent their smallest guardian into the Crownfall. The forest does not understand crowns. It understands roots.

champions.name: Kira Volt
champions.title: Arc-Tech Prodigy
champions.star1: A young arc-tech gunner with one compact energy pistol.
champions.star2: Dual energised pistols; her coat carries a glowing arc coil.
champions.star3: Floating arc batteries orbit her and every shot leaves a lightning trail.
champions.lore: Kira rebuilt her first pistol from a lightning rod. She intends to rebuild the Crown the same way.

champions.name: Grimm
champions.title: The Soldier Who Stayed
champions.star1: A skeletal footsoldier in dented plate, ghost-light in his ribs.
champions.star2: Plate reforged with spectral seams; a tattered banner grows from his back.
champions.star3: A deathless champion wreathed in green soulfire, his sword a shard of a fallen gate.
champions.lore: His war ended three centuries ago. Nobody told Grimm.

champions.name: Pip
champions.title: Demolitions Enthusiast
champions.star1: A tiny goblin-like sapper with a satchel of fizzing bombs.
champions.star2: Goggles, a bandolier of bigger bombs and a smoking backpack launcher.
champions.star3: Pip rides a ridiculous miniature mechanical war machine with a bomb chute.
champions.lore: Pip was told the Crownfall was a place of great explosions. Pip was not told correctly, so Pip brought his own.

champions.name: Solara
champions.title: Novice of the Dawn
champions.star1: A novice sun priestess with a simple brass staff.
champions.star2: Gilded vestments and a sun-disc staff that hums with light.
champions.star3: Radiant robes, a floating halo of three suns and wings of morning light.
champions.lore: Her order believes the Crown is the first sunrise, stolen. She has come to return it.

champions.name: Fen
champions.title: Blood of the Pack
champions.star1: A lean grey wolf warrior with bone-hilted claws.
champions.star2: Scarred and armoured in hide, crimson war paint glowing on his muzzle.
champions.star3: An alpha of the blood moon; a red spirit-wolf runs beside every leap.
champions.lore: Fen tracks weakness. He learned it from the winters, and the winters were thorough.

champions.name: Torren
champions.title: Shield of the Deep
champions.star1: A stone-skinned bearer behind a slab shield.
champions.star2: The shield becomes a carved gate with glowing gold veins.
champions.star3: A mountain made small: crystal spires grow from his shoulders and the shield bears a living rune.
champions.lore: The Titanborn say a shield is a promise. Torren has never broken one.

champions.name: Nyx
champions.title: The Quiet Hand
champions.star1: A hooded thief with two crooked daggers.
champions.star2: Her cloak drips living shadow; violet eyes glow beneath the hood.
champions.star3: Half shadow, half girl: a trail of afterimages follows her and her daggers are carved from night.
champions.lore: Nyx stole a star once. She gave it back. Mostly.

champions.name: Emberling
champions.title: Spark That Learned to Speak
champions.star1: A small living flame with curious coal eyes.
champions.star2: A crackling fire sprite crowned with blue-hot embers.
champions.star3: A miniature sun-spirit; the air warps around her and her fireballs leave spiralling trails.
champions.lore: She was a candle once. Then someone read a spell too close to her.

champions.name: Rowan
champions.title: Longbow of the Realm
champions.star1: A kingdom archer with a yew longbow.
champions.star2: Royal green tabard and a silver-limbed bow.
champions.star3: A legendary marksman: arrows of light, a lion cloak and a falcon familiar.
champions.lore: Rowan has never missed at a hundred paces. At a thousand, he says, the wind argues.

champions.name: Hexie
champions.title: Apprentice of Mischief
champions.star1: An apprentice witch in an oversized hat.
champions.star2: Her hat has grown eyes. Her staff has grown opinions.
champions.star3: A chaos witch riding a floating cauldron, hexes orbiting like fireflies.
champions.lore: Hexie is not supposed to be here. Neither was anything she has ever turned into a toad.

champions.name: Bolt
champions.title: Unit B-07
champions.star1: A compact combat automaton with one amber eye.
champions.star2: Reinforced plating, piston fists and a spinning gear core.
champions.star3: A gleaming brass guardian with a reactor heart and folding shield vanes.
champions.lore: Bolt was built to guard a door. The door is gone. Bolt has decided you are the door now.

champions.name: Kael
champions.title: Seeker of the Crown
champions.star1: A young swordsman in travelling leathers.
champions.star2: Blue-steel armour and a blade that leaves a crescent of light.
champions.star3: A crowned hero-in-waiting; his sword blazes with the sigil of a kingdom that does not exist yet.
champions.lore: Everyone in the Crownfall wants the Crown. Kael is the only one who wants to be worthy of it.

champions.name: Solenne Ash
champions.title: Knight of the Burning Dawn
champions.star1: A flame knight in rose-gold plate.
champions.star2: Her plume becomes fire; her blade glows white-hot.
champions.star3: Sun-forged armour, blazing wings and a trail of dawnfire.
champions.lore: Solenne swore to burn away every shadow in the Crownfall. She has started a list.

champions.name: Grizz
champions.title: The Mountain That Walks
champions.star1: An enormous bear warrior with iron-shod claws.
champions.star2: War-paint and a pauldron made from a mountain troll's skull.
champions.star3: A primal bear-titan whose roar shakes the arena floor.
champions.lore: Grizz does not understand the Crown. He understands that everyone wants it, and he likes a crowd.

champions.name: Gearwick-9
champions.title: Siege Calculator
champions.star1: A clockwork artillery robot with a brass mortar.
champions.star2: Twin barrels and a targeting monocle that clicks.
champions.star3: A walking siege tower with a rotary mortar crown.
champions.lore: Gearwick-9 has calculated the odds of winning the Crown. It will not tell you them.

champions.name: Mirella
champions.title: Voice of the Tides
champions.star1: A water mage with a swirling orb of seawater.
champions.star2: Robes of living foam and a coral circlet.
champions.star3: A tide queen: a ring of water orbits her and fish of light swim through it.
champions.lore: Mirella can hear every ocean. The Crownfall has none, and the silence frightens her.

champions.name: Shade
champions.title: The Mask With No Face
champions.star1: A masked assassin with a red-lacquered blade.
champions.star2: The mask cracks, revealing a crimson glow beneath.
champions.star3: A wraith of ribbons and knives; the mask floats in front of an empty hood.
champions.lore: Shade has worn many faces. The mask is the only one that stayed.

champions.name: Borin Ironbelly
champions.title: Forgekin Hearthbreaker
champions.star1: A broad Forgekin smith: basalt skin, braided beard of copper wire, a glowing hammer.
champions.star2: Magma veins open along his arms; his hammer head is a live forge.
champions.star3: Borin becomes a walking furnace; his beard is molten metal and every step leaves slag.
champions.lore: The Forgekin of Titan's Deep sing to metal until it agrees to become a hammer. Borin sings loudest.

champions.name: Seren
champions.title: Keeper of Starlings
champions.star1: A star-child with a lantern staff.
champions.star2: A cloak of night sky and a lantern that holds a real star.
champions.star3: Constellations sketch themselves around her; a flock of light-birds circles overhead.
champions.lore: Seren catches falling stars. Some of them want to fight.

champions.name: Thorn
champions.title: Blighted Bloom
champions.star1: A thorned plant warrior with a violet flower head.
champions.star2: Poison dripping from purple petals; a thorny spine along his back.
champions.star3: A carnivorous bloom colossus whose petals exhale toxic spores.
champions.lore: Not every forest wants visitors.

champions.name: Dax Meridian
champions.title: The Gun Between Worlds
champions.star1: A dimensional gunslinger in a dusty long coat.
champions.star2: Rift cracks glow along his revolver; his coat shows another sky.
champions.star3: A drifter from every timeline at once: ghostly copies echo his shots.
champions.lore: Dax has fought in forty-one realities. He lost in one, and he is still annoyed about it.

champions.name: Elara
champions.title: Field Surgeon of the Realm
champions.star1: A battlefield healer with a satchel of salves.
champions.star2: White-and-blue royal vestments; her tome glows.
champions.star3: An angel of the field hospital, light pouring from her open tome.
champions.lore: Elara has saved more soldiers than any general has led.

champions.name: Rask
champions.title: Pit Champion of Sszar
champions.star1: A reptilian gladiator with a notched gladius.
champions.star2: Gilded arena armour and a trophy belt.
champions.star3: The undefeated: golden scales and a cloak of every champion he has bested.
champions.lore: Rask counts in threes. So do his opponents, briefly.

champions.name: HEX-3
champions.title: Arcane Prototype
champions.star1: An experimental robot with a glass mana chamber.
champions.star2: Rune-etched plating; the reactor glows violet.
champions.star3: A levitating arcane engine with three orbiting reactor cores.
champions.lore: Prototypes one and two exploded. HEX-3 is careful. HEX-3 is very, very careful.

champions.name: Valkara
champions.title: Wing of Judgment
champions.star1: A winged celestial warrior with a spear-sword.
champions.star2: Wings of starlight and a gilded war-helm.
champions.star3: Six wings, a halo of blades and a dive that splits the sky.
champions.lore: Valkara judges. The verdict is usually "from above".

champions.name: Dreadmouth
champions.title: The Hunger Below
champions.star1: An enormous hollow creature that is mostly jaw.
champions.star2: Bone plates, a second jaw, and ghostfire in its throat.
champions.star3: A leviathan of the dead: an entire graveyard of teeth.
champions.lore: It ate a kingdom once. It is still hungry.

champions.name: Professor Spark
champions.title: Arc-Engineer Extraordinaire
champions.star1: A wild-haired engineer with a wrench and a tool-pack.
champions.star2: A mechanical arm grows from the pack; goggles spark.
champions.star3: He sits in a walking workshop that builds turrets on the fly.
champions.lore: Professor Spark was expelled from four academies for "excessive voltage".

champions.name: Orion
champions.title: The Constellation Sniper
champions.star1: A star-powered sniper with a crescent longbow.
champions.star2: Constellations glow across his armour; his bow draws starlight.
champions.star3: A hunter of gods: his arrows are comets.
champions.lore: Orion names every star he fires. He is running out of names.

champions.name: Maeve
champions.title: The Old Bargain
champions.star1: An ancient forest witch with a staff of living wood.
champions.star2: Antlers of bone and branch; her shadow is a tree.
champions.star3: The forest itself leans in to listen: moths of light circle her crown of antlers.
champions.lore: Maeve always keeps her bargains. That is what makes them frightening.

champions.name: Ronin Zero
champions.title: The Frame That Wanders
champions.star1: A cybernetic wandering swordsman with a straw-coloured visor.
champions.star2: Arc lines trace his frame; his blade hums.
champions.star3: He moves faster than his own afterimages; a lightning scabbard crackles at his hip.
champions.lore: Ronin Zero forgot his master's name. He did not forget the technique.

champions.name: Ignara
champions.title: The Living Pyre
champions.star1: A fire elemental warrior in cooling obsidian armour.
champions.star2: The armour cracks and roars with flame.
champions.star3: A pillar of fire in the shape of a woman; the air itself is burning.
champions.lore: Ignara was born in a volcano. She considers everywhere else cold.

champions.name: Morrow
champions.title: The Gravecaller
champions.star1: A gaunt necromancer with a bone scythe.
champions.star2: Ghostlights orbit him and his robes are stitched from banners.
champions.star3: A lord of the grave crowned in spectral candles.
champions.lore: Morrow believes death is a waste of good soldiers.

champions.name: Captain Blacktide
champions.title: Terror of the Rift Seas
champions.star1: A dimensional pirate captain with a hand cannon.
champions.star2: A spectral crew appears behind him; his coat drips seawater from nowhere.
champions.star3: A ghost galleon's figurehead rises behind him as he fires.
champions.lore: Blacktide sails seas that exist only between realities. He charges tolls.

champions.name: Aurelia
champions.title: Crown Commander
champions.star1: A royal battle commander in blue and gold.
champions.star2: A standard bearer marches behind her; her circlet glows.
champions.star3: Crowned in light, her banner becomes a column of gold.
champions.lore: Aurelia already has a crown. She wants to know why this one is bigger.

champions.name: Knuckle
champions.title: Pit King
champions.star1: An enormous stone pit fighter with taped fists.
champions.star2: Championship belts and cracks of gold in his granite skin.
champions.star3: A living landslide with fists like siege rams.
champions.lore: Knuckle has never lost a fight in the Underpits. He is here to see if the surface is any harder.

champions.name: Zyrak
champions.title: Shard of the Far Lattice
champions.star1: A crystal alien with a floating prism.
champions.star2: More facets, more light; a halo of crystal shards.
champions.star3: A walking cathedral of prisms refracting impossible colours.
champions.lore: Zyrak speaks in light. Most listeners go briefly blind; Zyrak considers this rude.

champions.name: Astryon
champions.title: The Seven-Star Blade
champions.star1: A silver celestial swordsman.
champions.star2: Gold-and-white armour; two celestial blades float at his back and constellations trail his strikes.
champions.star3: Cosmic armour, six spectral swords orbiting him and a starfield aura. His ultimate turns the arena to space.
champions.lore: Astryon has cut down seven stars. He intends the Crown to be the eighth.

champions.name: Queen Vespera
champions.title: Monarch of the Umbral Court
champions.star1: A pale shadow monarch on invisible stairs.
champions.star2: Her train becomes a river of shadow courtiers.
champions.star3: A throne of night rises behind her; her crown is an eclipse.
champions.lore: Vespera rules a court that exists only when no one is looking.

champions.name: Titan Rho
champions.title: The Last Fortress
champions.star1: An enormous ancient war machine on tread-legs.
champions.star2: Fold-out cannon towers and a reactor crown.
champions.star3: A walking citadel with a garrison of tiny brass drones.
champions.lore: Titan Rho guarded a city for ten thousand years. It does not know the city fell.

champions.name: Pyrax
champions.title: Dragon-Blooded
champions.star1: A dragon-blooded warrior with ember scales on her arms.
champions.star2: Horns and a burning tail; half her body is scaled.
champions.star3: She becomes a dragon in all but wings, and the wings are coming.
champions.lore: Pyrax's grandmother was a dragon. Pyrax intends to be one too.

champions.name: Elysian
champions.title: Grace of the Firmament
champions.star1: A serene celestial healer with feathered wings.
champions.star2: A second pair of wings and a halo of script.
champions.star3: A seraph of the firmament; her wings are made of dawn.
champions.lore: Elysian does not believe anyone deserves to die in the Crownfall. The Crownfall disagrees.

champions.name: General Varr
champions.title: The Unbroken Line
champions.star1: A grizzled kingdom commander with a tower shield.
champions.star2: Medals of every war and a banner-spear.
champions.star3: A legend of the line, flanked by phantom shieldbearers.
champions.lore: Varr has held every line he was given. He was never given the Crown.

champions.name: Veilwalker
champions.title: The Anomaly
champions.star1: A living dimensional anomaly in a tattered shape.
champions.star2: Its edges tear into other skies.
champions.star3: A hole in the world holding a blade.
champions.lore: The Veilwalker is what happens when a door between worlds learns to walk.

champions.name: Gaia Prime
champions.title: The Worldroot
champions.star1: An ancient living tree titan.
champions.star2: Blossoms and a canopy crown; birds nest in her shoulders.
champions.star3: A walking forest; the ground turns green where she stands.
champions.lore: Gaia Prime was old when the Crownfall was built. She remembers who built it.

champions.name: Lady Volt
champions.title: Thunder in Heels
champions.star1: An elite lightning duelist with a rapier.
champions.star2: Storm-silver armour; her hair crackles.
champions.star3: She is lightning with a sword; thunder arrives a heartbeat after her.
champions.lore: Lady Volt has never lost a duel. She considers most battles to be several duels at once.

champions.name: Vessimer
champions.title: The Tinctor
champions.star1: A masked chemist with a bandolier of vials.
champions.star2: Brass apparatus hisses on his back.
champions.star3: A mobile laboratory of floating flasks and glowing tubes.
champions.lore: Nobody has seen Vessimer's face. Vessimer is not sure he still has one.

champions.name: Aurex
champions.title: The Last Dragon
champions.star1: A massive dragon warrior.
champions.star2: Molten armour grows over his wings; fire leaks from every seam.
champions.star3: A full celestial dragon. The sky turns red and flames surround the arena.
champions.lore: Every dragon died for the Crown. Aurex is here to find out whether it was worth it.

champions.name: Noctara
champions.title: Empress of Nothing
champions.star1: An empress robed in the space between stars.
champions.star2: Her crown becomes an eclipse; small voids orbit her.
champions.star3: She is a doorway to nothing. The battlefield becomes the void.
champions.lore: Noctara ruled an empire until it disappeared. She is not sure she did not do it.

champions.name: ATLAS-Ω
champions.title: Final-Generation War Machine
champions.star1: A gigantic final-generation war machine.
champions.star2: Shoulder cannons and a reactor halo.
champions.star3: A titan of the last war: a sun burns in its chest.
champions.lore: ATLAS-Ω was built to end a war. It did. It is still waiting for its next order.

champions.name: Sol
champions.title: The First Light
champions.star1: The first light given a body.
champions.star2: A corona and four wings of light.
champions.star3: A miniature sun hangs above the arena.
champions.lore: Before anything, there was Sol. Sol would like it back that way.

champions.name: The Unwritten King
champions.title: Lord of the Forgotten
champions.star1: A skeletal king on a throne of shields.
champions.star2: A spectral legion stands behind him.
champions.star3: He remembers his name, and the dead answer it.
champions.lore: His name was erased from every record. He wants the Crown to write it back.

champions.name: Veyra Sol
champions.title: Reality Hunter
champions.star1: A huntress with portal-rings on her wrists.
champions.star2: Her cloak is a window into other worlds.
champions.star3: She exists in every reality at once, and all of them are hunting.
champions.lore: Veyra hunts things that escape between worlds. The Crown is the biggest one yet.

champions.name: Mother Verdant
champions.title: Life Eternal
champions.star1: The mother of forests, crowned in blossom.
champions.star2: Her train is a meadow; deer of light follow her.
champions.star3: A goddess of green whose every step is spring.
champions.lore: Every forest in every world is one of her children. She would like the Crown for the last one.

champions.name: Crownless
champions.title: The One Who Refused
champions.star1: A figure in broken regalia whose face is hidden.
champions.star2: Cracks of Crown-light spread through the armour.
champions.star3: The Crown's own power, worn as a body. Reality fractures around him.
champions.lore: Once, someone won the Crownfall. They refused the Crown. Nobody has explained why.
